constraints.name: interesting_element_definition
constraints.description: Each element of the array must be of the form 2^x - 1 where x is an integer between 1 and 60 inclusive.

constraints.name: xor_sum_requirement
constraints.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements of the array must equal the given integer C.

constraints.name: minimum_array_size
constraints.description: The array must have the smallest possible size n among all interesting arrays satisfying the XOR requirement.
